pr.title: Extract exact model prompts into versioned resources
pr.body:
## Summary

Little Say's model instructions and starter messages are embedded in business logic, making prompt changes difficult to find and review. This moves the existing text into documented top-level JSON resources with typed validation and literal substitution. Models receive the same requests, and parents see the same presets and behavior.

Server prompts stay server-only; shared presets use the existing Node/Expo loading paths. Account exports are preserved. Deferred ChatGPT grants in PR20 remain outside this change.

Closes #23.

## Test plan and behavior evidence

| Scenario | Expected and observed | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Run matching synthetic requests on actual master and the extracted resources, including Unicode, quotes, dollar signs, braces and newlines. | Complete serialized payloads and starter/preset outputs are byte-identical across affected operations, picture styles, speech languages and model selections. | [Fresh Before/After captures](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/comparison.json) |
| Load source and source-free ESM; export web, iOS and Android. | All three exports pass. Client bundles contain shared presets and exclude server-prompt markers. The relocated production server returns HTTP 200 with AI disabled; invalid resources/substitutions fail clearly. | [Runtime and bundle checks](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/runtime-report.json) |
| Create/refine starter boards and conversations with mocked providers, including cancellation and failed saves. | All 17 Chromium scenarios pass; prompts, drafts, consent and recovery remain intact. | [Browser results](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/oct09-browser.log) |

This is a non-UI extraction with unchanged request behavior; exact payload comparison is its observable Before/After contract. Fresh captures compare actual master `18aa7c0` with final source `29e8fa8c`. [Source, harness and artifact identities](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/manifest.json) and [applicability/retained originals](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/49195f9dd70ce9a9842c460e57348c3d73935cb2/applicability.json) are preserved outside product history.

## Supporting checks and limitations

`npm run check` passed: metadata, types, 320 tests, server build and web export. The merged runtime dependency supports passing iOS and Android exports. [Current-revision CI](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37870046517) and revision-scoped independent QA are recorded separately. The bot [declined this revision's review solely for quota](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/35#issuecomment-6072402436); no completed bot review is claimed.

Docker engine execution remains unperformed; its unchanged dist-copy contract and relocated runtime were checked. Native-device testing is deferred. No signed build, live inference, release or deployment was performed.

commit.message:
Restore iOS export with the missing Apple authentication runtime dependency (#44)

## Summary

Little Say's iOS JavaScript export fails because Apple authentication
imports `prop-types`, but the installed dependency graph does not
provide it. Declare it as a mobile production dependency so clean locked
installations can bundle the existing Apple authentication code.

The lockfile adds only `prop-types` 15.8.1 and its required nested
`react-is` 16.13.1. Existing package versions, integrity hashes and
classifications are unchanged; no provider code changes are needed.

Closes #43.

## Test plan and behavior evidence

| Scenario | Expected and observed | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install baseline and final source independently with `npm ci`, then
resolve the import from AppleButton and export iOS. | Baseline fails
with missing `prop-types`. Final resolves version 15.8.1 and its
required APIs, then completes the full iOS JavaScript export. Neither
installation uses copied or junctioned dependencies. | [Before/After
output and
reproduction](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/59a85fcf200da63e3a470c8e7847bab347a67161/README.md#before-and-after-observable-contract)
|
| Export Android/web and run repository checks from the fresh final
installation. | Both exports pass, along with 288 tests, type checks,
server build and release metadata validation. | [Native
exports](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/59a85fcf200da63e3a470c8e7847bab347a67161/issue43-native-exports.log)
· [Repository
checks](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/59a85fcf200da63e3a470c8e7847bab347a67161/issue43-check.log)
|

This is non-UI dependency resolution; real CLI output is the observable
Before/After contract.
[Provenance](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/59a85fcf200da63e3a470c8e7847bab347a67161/provenance.json)
binds actual master `fabb925c`, final source `a570b52c`, independent
installations, commands and bundle hashes.

## Limitations

JavaScript export success does not establish a signed iOS build,
TestFlight readiness, device behavior or real Apple sign-in. Those
checks were not performed. No credentials, provider setup, cloud build,
release or deployment is included.

Implementing task: `01a11ca6-7faa-7628-8031-ac89bc018019`. Independent
review and CI results are recorded in the PR discussion.

Co-authored-by: Codex <codex@openai.com>

issue.title: Extract agent prompts into versioned resource files
issue.body:
## Problem

Production prompt prose is embedded in business logic, making it hard to find, review and version. Separate application-authored model instructions and presets into discoverable top-level resources while preserving existing behavior.

## Requirements and acceptance

- Extract board/picture instructions, translation/transcription, speech instructions, starter-board concepts/template and the three conversation preset messages into `prompts/` resources with typed loading/substitution and a short caller/field guide. Keep UI labels, schemas, user history and board data in their current layers.
- Preserve exact assembled text, whitespace/order, literal substitutions and JSON data boundaries. Keep models, request options, consent/billing and cache identities unchanged; retain distinct wording rather than unifying prompts.
- Support source `tsx`, bundled Node ESM, the existing Docker layout, and Expo/Metro web/iOS/Android. Fail clearly for missing/invalid resources. Shared/mobile code must use no Node filesystem APIs or server-only prompts; production loading must not depend on source paths or the working directory.
- Prove exact before/after payload equality for all affected operations/styles, speech languages and presets, including Unicode, quotes, braces, dollar signs and newlines. Run `npm run check`, relevant mocked onboarding/conversation browser regressions, packaged runtime checks and all three client exports; report blocked checks honestly.
- No editor/layout changes, live inference, migrations, provisioning, credentials, deployment or merge. Pictures #6, PostgreSQL #15 and Expo setup #26 are merged. PR20 is explicitly deferred and absent from master, so its ChatGPT variants remain outside this extraction. Account PR24 was superseded by PR29; accounts and release orchestration #27 are not prerequisites. Preserve existing owners and branches.

## Implementation plan

1. Inventory current prompts on actual master; capture deterministic baseline requests before extraction.
2. Move exact content into server/shared resources, retain request assembly, and coordinate shared onboarding/preset imports without editor changes.
3. Verify payload equality, invalid-resource failures and packaged/client boundaries; publish a focused draft PR with retained evidence outside product history.

[Original requirements and plan](https://github.com/MChartier/agentic-development-workflow/blob/be7f2a00cbf9ced12d4b1a7a52f28e455695d7e3/issue-template-migration/little-say-23-original.md) · [Verified scope/assignment checkpoint](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/issues/23#issuecomment-6029576641)

## Implementing Codex task

Verified task ID: `01a11ca6-7faa-7628-8031-ac89bc018019` (Resolve prompt extraction conflict). [Original implementation record](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/60d8a2a150a5cce88733831f3a76169766c0087e/issue-readback.json) is preserved.

## Implementing PR

[PR35 — Extract exact model prompts into versioned resources](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/pull/35)

@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+# Prompt resources
+
+Application-authored model instructions and preset messages live here as UTF-8 JSON strings. JSON preserves significant leading/trailing whitespace and newlines independently of checkout line endings. Edit the values, not the loaders; do not trim, reflow or unify wording as part of a refactor.
+
+| Resource | Caller | Substitutions |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `server/board.json` | `apps/server/src/provider.ts`: board instructions, picture addendum, translation, transcription | None; the picture addendum starts with a newline |
+| `server/pictures.json` | `apps/server/src/picture-provider.ts`: analysis, selection, generation, review, both style briefs | `visualRules` in selection/review; `look` and JSON-serialized `concept` in generation |
+| `server/speech.json` | `apps/server/src/synthesis.ts`: Realtime speech instructions | `language` |
+| `shared/onboarding.json` | `packages/core/src/onboarding.ts`: starter concept lists and template | `concepts` |
+| `shared/conversation.json` | `apps/mobile/src/ui/AiConversation.tsx`: three suggestion messages | None; these intentionally differ from onboarding |
+
+`packages/core/src/promptResources.ts` checks required text and template fields at initialization. `{{field}}` substitution runs once with a callback, so dollar signs and template-looking text in supplied values remain literal. Request data stays in its existing JSON user message; schemas, models, options, consent, cache versions and UI labels remain with their existing owners.
+
+Shared/mobile code imports only `shared/` through `promptPresets.ts`, with no filesystem access. Server resources enter only through `apps/server/src/prompts.ts`. Static JSON imports work in `tsx` and Expo/Metro; tsup embeds them in the Node ESM output already copied by Docker. No resource reads depend on the runtime working directory or source tree.
+
+The payload and preset snapshot tests preserve SHA-256 fingerprints of complete serialized requests/text captured from master before extraction, including schemas and configured/default options. They use mocked transports, never live inference. Review intentional prompt changes against these baselines rather than blindly updating them. Resource-validation tests protect literal substitutions and clear failures. Run `npm run check`, the setup/conversation browser tests, and web/iOS/Android exports when changing the loading boundary.
+
+Deferred ChatGPT grants (PR20) are absent from this base. Their distinct prompts must be integrated separately if that work resumes.
